summary: FedEx Corp files an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting a notice of full redemption of its 1.300% Notes due 2031 (CUSIP 31428XBX3) with $354.878 million aggregate principal. The redemption date is May 28, 2026, at a price equal to the greater of par or a discounted present-value formula plus 25 basis points spread over a comparable government bond rate, plus accrued interest. The supplemental notice sets the aggregate redemption price at $358,619,289.16 including $3,741,289.16 accrued interest. This is a routine debt-refinancing action, not a special situation. No board recommendation or advisor; standard indenture mechanics. Watch for completion on May 28.
